visual.description: A digital document containing an examination schedule notice from Northbridge Institute of Technology.
visual.visible_text:
NORTHBRIDGE INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
Office of the Controller of Examinations
Ref: NIT/COE/2026/147
Date: 22 September 2026

NOTICE - Odd Semester Examination Schedule

All students of 3rd, 5th and 7th semester B.E. are informed that the odd semester examinations will commence on 10 November 2026. Hall tickets will be available on the student portal from 3 November 2026.

Examination fee: Rs. 4,800 (regular) Last date for payment: 5 October 2026
Payment mode: UPI to 9876543210@okaxis immediately to avoid late fee of Rs. 500

Students with attendance below 75% must contact their Head of Department before 15 October 2026.

Sd/-
Controller of Examinations
